en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a railway station with several empty platforms and tracks in the foreground. A long iron-and-glass canopy covers the central platforms. In the middle distance, a brick station building with a steep tiled roof and dormers bears a sign; further behind are several multi‑storey townhouses and a church or civic building with a tower. Platform lamps and signs marked with letters stand along the platforms. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century European town station.
